current.title: 课题组发布全奖博士招生信息
current.summary: 课题组发布面向2027年春季或秋季入学的博士招生信息，研究聚焦流域生物地球化学与地质背景调控的碳氮耦合循环。原文介绍了研究方向、申请要求及联系方式。
current.summary_en: The lab shared PhD opportunities for Spring or Fall 2027, focusing on watershed biogeochemistry and geological controls on coupled carbon–nitrogen cycling. See the original announcement for its requirements.
current.research_focus: Watershed biogeochemistry and geological controls on coupled carbon–nitrogen cycling
requirements: Background in hydrology, physical geography, environmental science or a related field.
Strong motivation for field investigations and experimental research.
English proficiency meeting the University’s admission requirements.

archived.title: 课题组发布地下水数值模拟研究助理招聘信息
archived.summary: 课题组于2025年发布研究助理招聘公告，工作内容包括地质体、地下水流与溶质运移三维建模，以及样品测试协助。原文保留了当时的岗位要求与申请方式。
archived.title_en: Research assistant recruitment in groundwater modeling
archived.summary_en: This 2025 announcement described a research assistant role involving geological, groundwater-flow and solute-transport modeling, together with laboratory support. The original post preserves the historical application details.
